en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. Abi (rah) from Ahmad b. Idris from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Ahmad b. Muhammad who raised it to Basheer al-Dahhan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who applies perfume to a Muslim, the Almighty Allah will grant him a light for each strand of his hair.”
